text:
Maria: Quick Q — if we add `message_flow=chunks` (streaming chunks with partial tool_call) will older SDKs that expect `streaming.delta` break? we have a customer on an old client.
Jake: short answer: yes, older clients parse `event.type === 'delta'` and will ignore new `chunk` event. we need a compat shim.
Ravi: proposal: runtime emits both: keep `delta` events but with `payload.parts` and also add `chunk` event for new clients. cost: ~+1k req/sec CPU for the serializer. Thoughts?
Sophie: forwarding to docs: we should document the `chunk` schema and add migration guide. Also suggest a feature flag `runtime.message_flow.mode=compat|strict` so customers can opt in.
Maria: ok — can we do opt-out instead? default compat and new strict opt-in via header? many customers won't update.
Jake: prefer default strict for performance but we can ship canary region with compat on. canary key: `mf.mode=compat` per-tenant. ops could enable for customer.
Ravi: implementation detail: add header `x-rw-mf-mode: compat` and runtime will duplicate events when set. Also add rollout toggle in console.
Sophie: filing docs ticket and migration checklist. tagging @doc-team. (reacted :eyes:)
Maria: who can take the quick PR to add the header parsing + shim? it's about ~120 LOC.
Jake: I can pick it up, but need a CR from @Ravi for perf. pinging you.
Ravi: got it. will review today. please add perf unit test and a microbenchmark in eng-runtime tests.
deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled to canary in 2h for feature flag rollout.
Maria: perfect. I'll update the customer-facing note and ping support after canary.
Sophie: thanks — adding to release notes: "message-flow: compat shim + header toggle".
Jake: PR link: https://git.redwood/company/eng-runtime/pull/4237 (WIP). please review ASAP.
Maria: closing loop: expected rollout timeline: canary -> 24h metrics -> prod if no regressions. keep us posted.
